methodology_notes: No Google Search Console, GBP Insights, or live Maps-ranking API access for this business; all findings come from public web search and direct fetches of the pages cited above. GBP absence, review absence, and query non-appearance are based on search-engine results rather than a direct load of the Google Maps UI, so those are labeled Likely rather than Verified. The zip-code discrepancy in the TDLR permit record was independently cross-checked against a zip-code lookup service and is labeled Verified. The Christian Brothers Automotive review count comes from a third-party aggregator (listen360) that may blend figures across locations; it is explicitly flagged as unverified at the exact-number level in competitors[]. No screenshots were captured for this record; none of the sources found (a government permit page, an aggregator review page) were judged to add enough visual evidence to justify capture for this pass. A prior single-page brief for this business exists at walk-in-briefs-sept2026/anna-automotive.html; its findings (no website, no reviews) were treated only as a lead to re-verify, not as a source, and were independently reconfirmed in this audit along with new findings (the zip-code error, named competitors with discovery method documented) that prior pass did not include.
